headline: Enneagram, from entry to detail
overview: Answer 144 questions to find your core type (1-9), wing, and instinctual subtype. Get your core fear, desire, integration/disintegration paths, and growth tips.
targetAudience: Users interested in personality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: 144-question assessment identifying your core Enneagram type (1-9), wing, and instinctual subtype
Reveals your core fear and core desire — the deep motivations driving your behavior
Integration and disintegration paths showing how you behave under growth vs. stress
Personalized growth tips tailored to your specific type and wing combination
tips: The Enneagram is about motivation, not just behavior — choose answers that reflect why you do things, not just what you do.
Pay attention to your integration path: understanding how you grow helps you intentionally move toward healthier patterns.
